cards.ex: I have to finish this report by Friday.
cards.exUz: Men bu hisobotni juma kuniga qadar tugatishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga majburiyat borligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: We're not allowed to use our phones during the meeting.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilish davomida telefonlarimizdan foydalanishga ruxsat yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga ruxsat berilmagan.

cards.ex: All employees are required to attend the safety training.
cards.exUz: Barcha xodimlar xavfsizlik bo'yicha treningda ishtirok etishlari talab qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun, qoida yoki vaziyatga ko'ra zarur.

cards.ex: I feel obligated to help them after all they've done for me.
cards.exUz: Ular menga qilgan barcha yaxshiliklardan keyin ularga yordam berishga majburman deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy yoki axloqiy jihatdan biror narsa qilishga majbur.

cards.ex: You're free to leave whenever you want.
cards.exUz: Qachon xohlasangiz ketishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga ruxsat etilgan va hech qanday majburiyat yo'q.

cards.ex: It's up to you whether you want to come or not.
cards.exUz: Kelish yoki kelmaslik o'zingga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Tanlash yoki qaror qabul qilish huquqi sizda.

cards.ex: It's my call, and I've decided to postpone the meeting.
cards.exUz: Bu mening qarorim va men yig'ilishni keyinga qoldirishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish huquqi meniki.

cards.ex: He thought he could get away with cheating on the test.
cards.exUz: U imtihonda aldashdan jazolanmasdan qutulish mumkin deb o'yladi.
cards.uzDef: Jazolanmasdan biror yomon ish qilish.

cards.ex: The company is bound to honor the contract.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya shartnomani bajarishga majbur.
cards.uzDef: Qonun, va'da yoki majburiyat bilan bog'langan.

cards.ex: As a full-time employee, you're entitled to paid vacation.
cards.exUz: To'liq ishlaydigan xodim sifatida siz pullik ta'tilga haqlisiz.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy yoki axloqiy jihatdan biror narsaga haqli.

cards.ex: You have the right to remain silent.
cards.exUz: Siz sukut saqlash huquqiga egasiz.
cards.uzDef: Qonun yoki axloqiy prinsiplar bilan berilgan imkoniyat.

cards.ex: The dress code for the event is left to one's discretion.
cards.exUz: Tadbir uchun kiyim kodi har kimning ixtiyoriga qoldirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining o'z ixtiyoriga qoldirilgan, o'zi hal qilishi mumkin.

cards.ex: You are under no obligation to accept this offer.
cards.exUz: Siz ushbu taklifni qabul qilishga majbur emassiz.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday qonuniy yoki axloqiy majburiyat mavjud emas.

cards.ex: That topic is out of bounds during family dinners.
cards.exUz: Bu mavzu oilaviy kechki ovqatlarda muhokama qilishga taqiqlangan.
cards.uzDef: Ruxsat etilmagan yoki taqiqlangan hudud yoki mavzu.

cards.ex: We've been given the green light to start the project.
cards.exUz: Bizga loyihani boshlashga ruxsat berildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga ruxsat olish, tasdiqlangan.

cards.ex: She always has her way, no matter what.
cards.exUz: U nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, har doim o'z xohishicha ish qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xohishiga ko'ra harakat qilish yoki o'z maqsadiga erishish.

cards.ex: I can't help but feel sorry for him.
cards.exUz: Men unga achinmasdan turolmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilmaslikning iloji yo'q.

cards.ex: He took liberties with my personal information.
cards.exUz: U mening shaxsiy ma'lumotlarim bilan chegaradan chiqib ketadigan darajada erkin munosabatda bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Chegaradan chiqib ketadigan darajada erkinlikdan foydalanish.

cards.ex: We might have to bend the rules a little to get this done.
cards.exUz: Buni amalga oshirish uchun qoidalarni biroz buzishimizga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga unchalik qat'iy rioya qilmaslik.

cards.ex: "Can I borrow your pen?" "By all means."
cards.exUz: "Sizning ruchkangizni olsam bo'ladimi?" "Albatta."
cards.uzDef: Rozilikni yoki ruxsatni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: You can decorate the office as you see fit.
cards.exUz: Ofisni xohlaganingizcha bezashingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'zingiz xohlagan tarzda qiling.

cards.ex: You mustn't touch the exhibits in the museum.
cards.exUz: Muzeydagi eksponatlarga teginish mumkin emas.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilish qat'iyan taqiqlangan.

cards.ex: He took it upon himself to organize the event.
cards.exUz: U tadbirni tashkil qilishni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan so'ramasdan yoki ruxsat olmasdan biror narsa qilish.

cards.ex: The manager was given carte blanche to make changes to the department.
cards.exUz: Menejerga bo'limda o'zgartirishlar kiritish uchun cheksiz vakolat berildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilish uchun cheksiz vakolat berilgan.

cards.ex: You are at liberty to express your opinion.
cards.exUz: Siz o'z fikringizni bildirishga erkinsiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilish uchun ruxsat yoki imkoniyatga ega.

cards.ex: She decided to shoulder the responsibility for the project's success.
cards.exUz: U loyihaning muvaffaqiyati uchun mas'uliyatni o'z zimmasiga olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Mas'uliyatni o'z zimmasiga olish va bajarish.

cards.ex: He'll have to answer for his actions.
cards.exUz: U o'z harakatlari uchun javob berishi kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki noto'g'ri harakatlar uchun javob berishga majbur.

cards.ex: Managers will be held accountable for their team's performance.
cards.exUz: Menejerlar o'z jamoalarining ishlashi uchun javobgar bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Xatti-harakatlari uchun javobgar bo'lishi kerak.

cards.ex: It is incumbent upon us to protect the environment.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish bizning vazifamizdir.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishi uchun rasmiy yoki axloqiy burch.

cards.ex: You ignore his advice at your peril.
cards.exUz: Agar uning maslahatiga e'tibor bermasangiz, xatar ostida qolasiz.
cards.uzDef: Agar ehtiyot bo'lmasa, yomon oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.
